description: Extension of the CronSettings view providing a SwiftUI interface for managing cron jobs, including UI components for job list, detail view, and scheduler status banners.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main SwiftUI view layout for the CronSettings extension, including headers, buttons, lists, and modals for managing cron jobs.

methods.name: schedulerBanner
methods.description: Displays a banner indicating whether the cron scheduler is enabled, and provides status information.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Provides the header section with title, description, and action buttons for refreshing and creating new jobs.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Main content area listing cron jobs and showing selected job details.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Shows detailed information for the selected cron job or a message prompting user to select a job.
